intro.uz: Aziza Moskvada yashaydigan akasi Jamshid bilan telefonda gaplashadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: bugun sizning shahringizda ob-havo qanday?

paragraphs.en: Aziza: Hello, Jamshid! How are you? How is Moscow? Jamshid: Hi, Aziza! I am fine, but it is very cold here. It is minus ten degrees today, and it is snowing.
paragraphs.uz: Aziza: Salom, Jamshid! Qalaysiz? Moskva qalay? Jamshid: Salom, Aziza! Yaxshiman, lekin bu yer juda sovuq. Bugun havo minus oʻn daraja, qor yogʻyapti.

paragraphs.en: Aziza: Here in Tashkent it is cold too, but it is sunny. It is five degrees. Jamshid: Five degrees? That is warm for me! What are you wearing?
paragraphs.uz: Aziza: Bu yerda, Toshkentda ham sovuq, lekin quyoshli. Havo besh daraja. Jamshid: Besh daraja? Men uchun bu iliq-ku! Ustingda nima bor?

paragraphs.en: Aziza: I am wearing a coat and a hat. Jamshid: I am wearing a warm jacket, a scarf and gloves. I never go out without my gloves in winter.
paragraphs.uz: Aziza: Men palto va shapka kiyib olganman. Jamshid: Men issiq kurtka, sharf va qoʻlqop kiyib olganman. Qishda hech qachon qoʻlqopsiz koʻchaga chiqmayman.

paragraphs.en: Aziza: Be careful! Jamshid: Don't worry. I like the snow. Bye!
paragraphs.uz: Aziza: Ehtiyot boʻling! Jamshid: Xavotir olma. Men qorni yaxshi koʻraman. Xayr!

title.uz: Ob-havo: it is cold, it is snowing

title.uz: Hozir kiyib turgan narsa: I am wearing
